title: HELIX Bridge: PeopleSoft HCM → BenefitEnrollment

source_objects.description: Health plan enrollment: EMPLID, PLAN_TYPE, BENEFIT_PLAN, COVERAGE_BEGIN_DT, COVERAGE_END_DT, COVRG_CD (coverage code: EE, EE+SP, EE+CH, FAM).
Life/AD&D insurance enrollment: PLAN_TYPE, BENEFIT_PLAN, FLAT_AMOUNT or COVERAGE_MULTIPLE.
Retirement/savings: PLAN_TYPE, BENEFIT_PLAN, SAVINGS_PCT (employee contrib %), EMPL_CONTRBN_PCT, ER_MATCH_PCT.
Defined benefit pension: PLAN_TYPE, BENEFIT_PLAN, SERVICE_DT.
Plan definitions: PLAN_TYPE, BENEFIT_PLAN, DESCR, PROVIDER.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Map PS PLAN_TYPE codes: '1x' → 'medical', '2x' → 'dental', '3x' → 'vision', '4x' → 'life', '5x' → 'disability', '6x' → 'retirement', '7x' → 'fsa'. Actual codes are institution-configurable.

attribute_mappings.source: Derived from deduction tables (PS_DEDUCTION_TBL) or benefit cost tables
attribute_mappings.transformation: Per-period employee premium. PS stores this in payroll deduction tables, not directly on the benefit enrollment.

notes: PS Benefits uses PLAN_TYPE as the primary classifier (10=Medical, 2x=Dental, etc. — institution-configurable). COVRG_CD drives the coverage level and premium. Dependent data is in PS_DEPENDENT_BENEF. Tuition waiver is often a separate PLAN_TYPE. 403(b) and state pension are in PS_SAVINGS_PLAN/PS_PENSION_PLAN.
